comments.body:
This is the fuseki configuration I'm currently using: https://gist.github.com/acoburn/ff8984ab4407dc02962e5db4b4466222

It includes an OWL reasoner and loads a number of ontologies (stored in /etc/fuseki) on startup, including: dcterms, dc, skos, wgs84, foaf, ldp and fedora.

I would note that that the dataset name is "fedora" – we'd want to change that to "test" for vagrant.

PRs:
vagrant-base-box: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo4-vagrant-base-box/pull/3
vagrant: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo4-vagrant/pull/46

Please note: I have tested this configuration on stand-alone deployments of Fuseki, but not in vagrant.
Inferencing is not working in the current config.
Ok. We shall fix it. Chat in irc on Tuesday? (It's a holiday weekend in Canada.)

The reasoning did not work as I expected, given:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo4-vagrant-base-box/pull/3/files#diff-6e16a2e39e7246b41c4d73f1a8c89046R38

But if I perform the following request on Fuseki after starting vagrant:

curl -i -XPOST -H"Content-Type: application/sparql-update" --data-binary @reason.ru http://localhost:8080/fuseki/test/update

with reason.ru:

PREFIX ldp: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#>
PREFIX fedora: <http://fedora.info/definitions/v4/repository#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

INSERT {
  fedora:hasParent owl:inverseOf ldp:contains .
} WHERE {}

The expected, inferenced, "ldp:contains" triples show up.

I am pretty certain that you can get this to work properly with either of the following two methods:

1) Change the fuseki version from 2.3.1 -> 2.4.0

OR

2) Change the location of the ja:content triple – I recall that for v2.3.1 I had to define that directly on the model as in https://gist.github.com/acoburn/ff8984ab4407dc02962e5db4b4466222

I think the first option would be the best.
I'll create a ticket to update Fuseki to 2.4.0 in the base box. I'll see if I can get it done this week.

https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo4-vagrant-base-box/pull/5

Nick Ruest? Unknown? could one of you test that this update does indeed enable the desired inferencing: ldp:contains <-> fedora:hasParent

I tested it by executing the following request:

curl -i -XPOST -H"Content-Type: application/sparql-update" --data-binary @test.ru http://localhost:8080/fuseki/test/update

Where, test.ru is:

PREFIX ldp: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#>
PREFIX fedora: <http://fedora.info/definitions/v4/repository#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

INSERT {
  <info://child> fedora:hasParent <info://parent> .
} WHERE {}

..followed by the query in Fuseki of:

select * where {
  ?s ?p <info://child>
}
vagrant box update

This task is to add OWL reasoning to the Fuseki installation on fcrepo4-vagrant.
The immediate driving use case is to allow fcrepo-indexing-triplestore to "omit" "http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#PreferContainment" (i.e. ldp:contains) triples but still be able to infer the same relationships via:

INSERT

{ fedora:hasParent owl:inverseOf ldp:contains . }

WHERE {}

These Fuseki updates will likely occur in fcrepo4-vagrant-base-box:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo4-vagrant-base-box

The completion of this ticket should also include rolling back:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo4-vagrant/pull/41
